1: ## 1. Pre-flight gates (must complete before /opsx:apply runs)
2: 
3: - [ ] 1.1 Spike C (`spike-handwriting-stroke-library`) archived with weighted-coverage ≥95% on top 30 Phase 0 snapshots
4: - [ ] 1.2 Spike D (`spike-elevenlabs-streaming-latency`) archived with first-audio-chunk p95 ≤500 ms from Sydney
5: - [ ] 1.3 Master plan AD34/AD35/AD36/AD37 entries verified live in `steve-master-plan-20260409-165323.md`
6: - [ ] 1.4 BUILD_PROMPTS.md Phase 2 prompts replaced with multi-beat prompt sequence
7: 
8: ## 2. Schema + database
9: 
10: - [ ] 2.1 Migration `supabase/migrations/<ts>_stuck_events_multi_beat.sql` adds `beat_count int`, `planner_model text`, `classifier_verdict text`, `per_beat_tokens jsonb`
11: - [ ] 2.2 Migration includes RLS policy parity with existing `stuck_events` policies (no policy gap)
12: - [ ] 2.3 `bun run db:migrate` runs cleanly against dev Supabase project (`pentra` @ `jsrcbwxrbwyfzcwgtqxy`)
13: - [ ] 2.4 `bun run test:rls` passes after migration
14: - [ ] 2.5 Add `BeatSchema`, `BeatSequenceSchema`, and `ClassifierVerdictSchema` to `src/lib/ai/schemas.ts` with full Zod coverage
15: 
16: ## 3. AI Gateway extensions
17: 
18: - [ ] 3.1 Extend `src/lib/ai/gateway.ts` to expose a streaming planner call (`callPlannerStream`) returning an async iterator of raw beat JSON chunks
19: - [ ] 3.2 Add `google/gemini-flash-2.5` and `google/gemini-3-pro` to the model union and to `src/lib/ai/pricing.ts` price sheet
20: - [ ] 3.3 Add `callClassifier` helper in `src/lib/ai/classifier.ts` with 1500 ms timeout + classifier-system-prompt constant
21: - [ ] 3.4 Snapshot-hash classifier cache: `src/lib/ai/classifier-cache.ts` keyed by SHA-256 of normalized JPEG, 24h TTL via Upstash
22: - [ ] 3.5 Per-session Gemini 3 Pro cap helper in `src/lib/ai/session-quota.ts` (Upstash counter keyed by `session_id`)
23: - [ ] 3.6 Frozen classifier system prompt in `src/lib/ai/prompts/classifier-system.ts` — contains the verbatim hard-problem definition
24: - [ ] 3.7 Frozen multi-beat planner system prompt in `src/lib/ai/prompts/planner-system.ts` — enforces ≤25 words per `say`, ≤6 beats per sequence
25: 
26: ## 4. Server route — POST /api/stuck/stream
27: 
28: - [ ] 4.1 Create `src/app/api/stuck/stream/route.ts` (Node runtime, `maxDuration: 30`)
29: - [ ] 4.2 Reuse Prompt 18 plumbing: kill-switch check, IP limiter, auth, idempotency, user quota, spend circuit breaker, request_id wrapping
30: - [ ] 4.3 Pipeline: classifier (with cache) → planner selection → streaming planner call → per-beat Zod validation → SSE emission
31: - [ ] 4.4 SSE wire format: `text/event-stream`, `data: <beat-json>\n\n`, `data: [DONE]\n\n` terminator
32: - [ ] 4.5 Implement 6-second time-to-first-beat watchdog — abort multi-beat path and emit single-shot envelope past budget
33: - [ ] 4.6 Implement 20-second whole-sequence watchdog — emit `data: [TIMEOUT]\n\n` and close
34: - [ ] 4.7 Server-side per-beat schema parse with drop-and-continue on failure (track `dropped_beats` for telemetry)
35: - [ ] 4.8 Whole-sequence Sonnet schema failure: retry once → escalate to Gemini 3 Pro → degrade to single-beat envelope
36: - [ ] 4.9 Feature flag `MULTI_BEAT_STREAM_ENABLED` env-var check (default false in prod, true in preview)
37: - [ ] 4.10 Write extended `stuck_events` row on stream completion (success, partial, or degraded)
38: 
39: ## 5. Server route — /api/stuck graceful degradation
40: 
41: - [ ] 5.1 Update `/api/stuck` to call into the same planner pipeline but return only the first beat as a `StuckResponseSchema` envelope
42: - [ ] 5.2 Confirm all existing Prompt 18 idempotency and rate-limit behaviour still passes its integration suite
43: 
44: ## 6. Client — stroke renderer module
45: 
46: - [ ] 6.1 Create `src/lib/canvas/stroke-renderer/index.ts` exposing `playStrokes`, `resolveBeatToStrokes`, `compose*` helpers
47: - [ ] 6.2 Load Spike C glyph library JSON at module init; cache resolved beats in-memory per session
48: - [ ] 6.3 Composer functions: `composeFraction`, `composeRadical`, `composeExponent`, `composeIntegral` — each emits ordered atomic strokes
49: - [ ] 6.4 Fallback path: KaTeX-rendered HTML span with 200 ms ease-in for unsupported glyphs
50: - [ ] 6.5 Telemetry: emit `glyph_unsupported_rendered` PostHog event per missing glyph
51: - [ ] 6.6 Unit tests in `src/lib/canvas/stroke-renderer/*.test.ts` covering composer ordering, fallback path, and unsupported-glyph telemetry (≥80% coverage per AD1)
52: 
53: ## 7. Client — Annotation layer + SSE consumer
54: 
55: - [ ] 7.1 Create `src/components/canvas/AnnotationLayer.tsx` consuming SSE via `EventSource`
56: - [ ] 7.2 Per-beat lifecycle: receive → start ElevenLabs websocket TTS request → start `playStrokes` in parallel → wait `pause_ms` → next beat
57: - [ ] 7.3 Maintain `strokesAddedSinceSnapshot` bbox tracker; pass to `resolveAnchor` for collision-recovery shifting
58: - [ ] 7.4 Greedy anchor shift implementation (below → right → above) inside canvas bounds; drop beat if all directions exhausted
59: - [ ] 7.5 "Pentra is working on a harder problem…" loading state when classifier verdict is `hard`
60: - [ ] 7.6 "Pentra got cut off — tap for more" affordance on `[TIMEOUT]` SSE frame
61: - [ ] 7.7 "Got it" action fades all rendered strokes to 40% opacity (parity with Prompt 18 single-shot persistence)
62: 
63: ## 8. Client — ElevenLabs streaming integration
64: 
65: - [ ] 8.1 `src/lib/ai/elevenlabs-stream.ts` opens a websocket, streams audio chunks, returns first-chunk timestamp
66: - [ ] 8.2 Fallback chain: streaming → non-streaming → Web Speech API → silent-with-caption
67: - [ ] 8.3 `ELEVENLABS_STREAMING_ENABLED` env kill-switch
68: - [ ] 8.4 Drift telemetry: emit `voice_annotation_sync_drift_ms` per beat to PostHog
69: 
70: ## 9. Failure-path test matrix (integration)
71: 
72: - [ ] 9.1 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-classifier-fail.test.ts` — classifier 500 → Sonnet path runs and emits beats
73: - [ ] 9.2 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-sonnet-schema-fail.test.ts` — bad Sonnet response → Gemini 3 Pro fallback
74: - [ ] 9.3 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-gemini-fail.test.ts` — both planners fail → single-beat envelope returned
75: - [ ] 9.4 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-bad-beat.test.ts` — one malformed beat is dropped, sequence continues
76: - [ ] 9.5 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-timeout.test.ts` — stream exceeds 20s → `[TIMEOUT]` frame emitted
77: - [ ] 9.6 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-session-cap.test.ts` — second `hard` verdict in same session forces Sonnet
78: - [ ] 9.7 `tests/integration/classifier-cache.test.ts` — same `snapshot_hash` skips classifier call within 24h
79: - [ ] 9.8 `tests/integration/api-stuck-stream-kill-switch.test.ts` — `AI_STUCK_FLOW_ENABLED=false` returns 503 (no SSE stream opened)
80: 
81: ## 10. Client tests
82: 
83: - [ ] 10.1 `src/components/canvas/AnnotationLayer.test.tsx` — collision-recovery shifts, glyph-unsupported fallback render, "Got it" fade
84: - [ ] 10.2 `tests/perf/canvas-stroke-latency.test.ts` extended with 6-beat sequence case asserting p95 ≤16 ms
85: - [ ] 10.3 Playwright visual regression: add multi-beat in-progress state and post-"Got it" 40% state
86: 
87: ## 11. Telemetry + cost dashboard
88: 
89: - [ ] 11.1 Extend PostHog `stuck_completed` event with `beat_count`, `time_to_first_beat_ms`, `planner_model`
90: - [ ] 11.2 Add `glyph_unsupported_rendered` PostHog event with `{ glyph, beat_index, request_id }`
91: - [ ] 11.3 Add `beat_anchor_drop` PostHog event with `{ original_anchor, blocking_bbox, request_id }`
92: - [ ] 11.4 Update AI cost dashboard: per-press cost (classifier + planner), Gemini 3 Pro daily spend line, time-to-first-beat p95
93: - [ ] 11.5 Confirm `AI_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD` circuit breaker still trips when classifier + planner combined cost exceeds cap
94: 
95: ## 12. Rollout
96: 
97: - [ ] 12.1 Feature flag `MULTI_BEAT_STREAM_ENABLED` defaults off in prod, on in preview environments
98: - [ ] 12.2 Beta canary: flip flag on for the 10 closed-beta accounts via `/api/me`-driven flag
99: - [ ] 12.3 Monitor for 5 days: `time_to_first_beat_ms` p95 ≤6 s, `beat_count` distribution, `glyph_unsupported_rendered` rate <20%, ElevenLabs streaming success ≥95%
100: - [ ] 12.4 G3 qualitative gate review including "did this feel like a human tutor?" question
101: - [ ] 12.5 Cut to default for everyone after canary clean + G3 pass
102: - [ ] 12.6 Document rollback procedure in `docs/ops/rollback-multi-beat.md` (flip the flag — instant revert; schema columns stay additive)
103: 
104: ## 13. Cleanup (post-launch, ≥2 weeks default-on with no rollbacks)
105: 
106: - [ ] 13.1 Slim down `/api/stuck` graceful-degradation path (still kept as fallback, no longer feature-flag gated)
107: - [ ] 13.2 Archive this change via `/opsx:archive multi-beat-tutor-response` after specs sync
